name: table_pivot
description: Group-by and pivot tables over CSV text: group rows by key columns and aggregate value columns with sum, count, mean, min, max and count distinct in exact Decimal arithmetic; optionally spread one column's values across the output columns (rows x columns) with a fill value for empty cells; row totals, a total row and the grand total computed from the underlying rows (a mean of all values, not of the cell means). Numeric keys sort as numbers. JSON rows and CSV.

path.description: Or a relative path to a CSV file

columns.description: Pivot column: its values become output columns

fill.description: Value for empty pivot cells (default null)

decimals.description: Round results half-up to this many places

input.csv:
region,quarter,amount
North,Q1,10
North,Q1,5.5
North,Q2,7
South,Q1,3
South,Q2,4.25

catalog.source: original; semantics of spreadsheet pivot tables and pandas pivot_table (margins computed from the data); Python decimal
